selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a prison/correctional facility and not a generic industrial space.
To verify the structural integrity of the multi-level bars and ensure no 'melting' or spatial inconsistencies in the complex grid patterns.
To ensure individual bars are distinct, continuous entities without fusion or blurring into the background.
To detect subtle texture anomalies or lighting inconsistencies common in AI-generated interiors.

focus_areas: Structural consistency of vertical and horizontal bars
Perspective alignment of cell doors and walkways
Texture realism of concrete walls and metal surfaces
Lighting coherence from the upper windows
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection points of the metal bars. AI generators often struggle with complex grids, causing bars to merge or disappear. Verify that the depth perception between the foreground gate and the background cells is physically accurate.
